lena: Heads-up: p95 gen latency jumped in eu-west3 around 09:04 and PCIe err counters ticked. suspect a bursty embedding job.
arjun: I looked — tenant=beta-embeds started a 200k-batch run, single job with very large DMA transfers. NVLINK + PCIe bursts saturated host DMA and pushed NIC qdepth.
lena: logs:
```
[2026-03-23T09:03:58Z] host: pcie_dma_burst=1.2GB/s tenant=beta-embeds job=job-8923
[2026-03-23T09:04:02Z] nic: tx_qlen=11000 -> dropped pkts
[2026-03-23T09:04:05Z] runtime: request_latency p95=420ms (baseline 120ms)
```
sofia: Classic noisy-IO neighbor. We have two levers: 1) immediate routing -> steer heavy-IO label to dedicated-io pool (extra $/hr), or 2) soft-isolate via IO-shaper on host NIC + throttle large DMA windows.
arjun: Routing to dedicated pool buys isolation but costs. For a 200k-batch embed run that's ~18 GPU-hours; dedicated slice markup ~30% -> additional cost ~5.4 GPU-hours worth. But it would remove collateral latency for other tenants.
lena: What about soft-isolation per-tenant? we could enforce per-tenant io_budget with burst windows (e.g., 500MB/s for bursts up to 10s, then backoff). That would throttle the job but avoid full reroute.
sofia: Short-term playbook: tag the running job with label heavy-io -> infra rule to apply nic-shaping + warn customer. Long-term: add \"io_budget\" field to tenant profile and surface to console + billing.
nate: Ops steps I can take now: add flow rule to host group eu-west3-rack5 to drop excessive DMA windows and add a slow-path for beta-embeds. If we do route -> dedicated-io, need to ensure model variant compatibility (quantized instances present).
arjun: Also watch for slab churn — big DMA bursts cause HBM hotspots and KVCACHE thrash. Add slab_eviction_rate and dma_burst_rate to the alert graph.
sofia: Proposed immediate action items: 
- nate: apply nic-shape rule to rack5 for tenant=beta-embeds (10m window)
- lena: add temporary alert: dma_burst_rate{region=\"eu-west3\"} > 800MB/s for 1m -> page oncall
- arjun: create routing rule draft: heavy-io -> dedicated-io fraction=0.1 (canary)

lena: infra-bot can you start canary for the nic-shape rule?
infra-bot: canary rollout initiated: nic-shape/rate-limit -> eu-west3-rack5 (5% hosts)
sofia: Monitoring queries to watch during canary:
```
curl 'https://prom/api/v1/query?query=pcie_dma_rate{region=\"eu-west3\"}'
curl 'https://prom/api/v1/query?query=host_p95_latency{service=\"inference\"}'
```
arjun: Cost proposal for product: add \"io-isolation\" SKU priced by io-hours and delta GPU markup. Will draft numbers after we see one more episode.
lena: tagging @oncall and @customer-success to prep comms if we enforce routing. :loud_sound:
sofia: putting a short runbook PR: /docs/runbooks/noisy-io-neighbor.md (draft)
lena: thanks — rolling watch for 30m. if latency recovers, we revert nic-shape; if not, escalate to dedicated routing.
